dialogues.speaker: Tvrdo
dialogues.text: Who am I? I'm just a hard worker. And these are my brothers, who work hard with me.

dialogues.speaker: Tvrdo
dialogues.text: Ask anyone on the docks — when it comes to this kind of work, me and my crew get it done right and clean. No contest!

dialogues.speaker: Tvrdo
dialogues.text: That said... Times have changed. Those iron beasts don't need to eat, they don't get tired, and they don't go around yelling at debtors. It's been a long time since anyone's shelled out for pure muscle and hustle!

dialogues.speaker: Tvrdo
dialogues.text: But tell you what, our strength is more than a match for any metal machine!
